==Behind the scenes==
The inquisitor was mentioned in the opening story for ''[[Savage Spirits]]'', a<ref name="Savage" /> [[2016]]<ref name="FFGWeb">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2016/6/2/savage-creatures|text=Savage Creatures|date=2016-06-02}}</ref> [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] sourcebook for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny]]''.<ref name="Savage" /> The opening fiction was written by [[Tim Huckelberry]],<ref name="Author">{{Apple|subdomain=podcasts|url=us/podcast/the-order-66-podcast-episode-80-an-interview-with-savages/id276381727?i=1000541432407|text=The Order 66 Podcast Episode 80 - An Interview With Savages|date=2016-07-24}}</ref> lead developer for the sourcebook.<ref name="Savage" />
